title: Shellability of 3-cut complexes of powers of cycle graphs
summary: In connection with commutative algebra, Bayer et al. introduced cut complexes in [Topology of cut complexes of graphs, SIAM J.\ Discrete Math., 38(2):1630-1675, 2024]. For a positive integer $k$, the $k$-cut complex of a graph $G$, denoted as $Δ_k(G)$, is the simplicial complex whose facets are the $(|V(G)|-k)$-subsets $σ$ of the vertex set $V(G)$ of $G$ such that the induced subgraph $G[V(G) \setminus σ]$ is disconnected.
